depiction.primary_object: three stacked horizontal bars representing a list or text
depiction.composition: horizontal lines stacked on the left with a checkmark beside the shorter bottom line

ambiguity: Can be mistaken for a generic menu icon with a badge, or an 'add to playlist' confirmation icon in media apps.

modifier_semantics.meaning: completed, verified, approved, or checked off

reasoning: The icon depicts three stacked horizontal lines with a checkmark at the bottom right, universally understood as a checklist, completed list, or verified text. In a task manager it is somewhat self-referential, but it fits tasks that are specifically about running through a checklist, verifying an inventory list, or proofreading text. It can be confused with other list/clipboard icons or a UI menu button.
